artworks.title: The City of Arnberg in the Oberpfalz
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over traces of graphite, with borderlines in pen and black ink, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a higher vantage point overlooking a town in the distance. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the painting, with the town's skyline, including church towers. The brushwork is delicate and smooth, capturing details of the natural and built environments. The color palette is soft and subtle, with muted earth tones in the hills and fields, alongside blues and grays in the sky and clouds. Two figures are walking along a path with grazing sheep, rocky terrain, and small trees. A green landscape slopes downward toward a river before leading to the town. The sky is expansive with fluffy clouds on a calm, overcast day.

artworks.title: Fridolin and Two Workmen by the Forge
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on laid (?) paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 27 x 34.5 cm (10 5/8 x 13 9/16 in.), including border with trial colors
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals outside a rustic building. One man is seated wearing a white shirt and a long brown apron, pointing upwards. Beside him, another man wears a brown cap and dark vest, engaging in conversation with a standing person. The standing individual wears a blue doublet, white tights, and green-brown shoes, along with a black hat with a white feather. They seem to be pointing at the seated man's chest. Rustic elements like a table with a jug, a barrel, a basket, and a wheel surround them. The background includes mountains, a distant church, and a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Two Women in the Kitchen
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk with stumping on old laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two people sitting, likely showing them from the waist up. One person, presumably a woman, is positioned slightly forward and facing towards the other person. Details in her facial features, such as the structure of her nose and mouth, as well as her hair, are visible. The clothing of the individuals is suggested with lines indicating the shape of loose garments fitting the period style, possibly dresses or aprons. The setting is a dim interior space, with what looks like a window behind them, allowing a bit of light to contrast against the figures. An artist's signature, "W. Luks," is visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: The Contest between Apollo and Pan before King Midas
artworks.medium: black and gray wash and  white gouache on gray prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of three figures. The central figure is prominent in a profile position, facing slightly to the right, holding a long serpent that winds around their body. The central figure has distinct facial features, curly hair, and is minimally adorned with a cloth. Two additional figures are present. One figure on the left is kneeling, and the figure on the right is seated or crouching. The background features dark, textured shading, possibly suggesting a natural setting. The drawing has a monochrome quality and uses dynamic shading techniques.

artworks.title: Principe Massimiliano Massimi
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing of a man's face shown from the shoulders up. The man is depicted in a partial profile facing slightly to the right, with his head turned slightly toward the viewer. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. He has neatly combed short, light-colored hair with slight waves. The man is wearing a high-collared shirt that is faintly sketched. There is no indication of any jewelry or objects present. The background is plain and unadorned. The edges of the drawing paper are slightly textured, lending an aged appearance to the image.

artworks.title: The Madonna Enthroned with Saint John the Baptist and Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite, heightened with white gouache, incised throughout and verso reddened for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals arranged in a symmetrical composition. In the center, a seated woman holds a child. Two other seated figures are on either side of them, each holding a symbolic object. The central figures have styled hair and appear with halos. Two kneeling angels with wings are in the foreground, facing the central subjects and holding scrolls. Draped curtains in the background frame the scene.

artworks.title: Standing Male Nude from Behind
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping and black chalk and white gouache on orange wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: A Man Bending Over
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white oil paint, squared for transfer with graphite, on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a young male figure in a bent position. He is reaching towards the ground with one hand, while his other hand is not visible. The man has short, neatly combed hair and is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark suspenders, pressed trousers, and polished shoes. The background consists of a plain brownish surface with visible sketch grid lines.

artworks.title: The Contest between Apollo and Pan before King Midas
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, corrected with white gouache, over traces of graphite, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a violinist in a wooded setting. The monochromatic drawing depicts an assembly of individuals, some seated and others standing, with one playing a violin in the center. The scene is set against a backdrop of rocks and trees. There is a sense of movement and interaction among the figures, with some appearing to listen intently to the music. The drawing utilizes light and shadow to give depth and dimension to the figures and the natural elements surrounding them. The style of this drawing could suggest mannerist influences, with elongated forms and dramatic, yet fluid poses.

artworks.title: Corner of a Meadow with a Stream
artworks.medium: brush and dark brown ink, with framing lines in pen and black ink and graphite, on very light green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, obscured by hills and bushes, with subtle lines of vegetation and small trees leading into the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, with expressive lines and washes creating a sense of movement in the foliage and water. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of brown and sepia tones. A stream winds through rocky and bushy terrain, with detailed textures, and in the distance, the land blends smoothly with the sky.

artworks.title: The Artist's Son Wolf Crouching on the Floor
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an inset portrait of a person sitting on the floor from head to knees, with one arm resting on the knee. The individual is looking upwards with a focused gaze. The person's facial features include closely set eyes, a small nose, and slightly parted lips. They have short, closely cropped hair and are wearing casual clothing - a long-sleeved top, pants, and an additional garment draped over their shoulders. An open book is on the ground in front of them. The background is sketched with textured shading, hinting at an interior scene.

artworks.title: Johann Evangelist Scheffer von Leonhardshoff
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a person in profile, facing left. The individual has distinct facial features, including a straight nose and closed lips, with eyes looking forward. The person's hair is straight, parted on the side, falling to the ear and beyond. They are wearing a high-collared garment. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain. The name and dates at the bottom indicate the portrait is of Johannes Scheffer, Ritter von Leonartshof, born in 1796 and died on January 12, 1822.

artworks.title: The Artist's Daughter Käthe Reading in a Chair
artworks.medium: black chalk and heightened with white chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated in an armchair, engrossed in reading a book. She has short dark hair, is wearing a light-colored dress, and dark-striped socks. The chair has sketched lines indicating a cushioned texture, and there are fabric details on the lower part of the chair. The background is minimal with indistinct lines.

artworks.title: The Sabine Hills and Rocca Santo Stefano Seen from Civitella
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position. There are mountains meeting the sky at the horizon. Soft, rolling hills blend into mountain ranges in the distance, creating depth. The brushstrokes are delicate, giving a watercolor texture. The color palette consists of pastel shades - light blues, greens, and earthy browns dominate. Closest to us are gentle slopes with vegetation and pathways.

artworks.title: A Ferry on the Königsee
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white chalk,  over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering near a body of water. The horizon is in the lower part of the composition, with water extending to the left and plants lining the shore. People are boarding or leaving a small boat, while others are gathered near a rustic structure against rocky cliffs. The artist's style uses loose brushstrokes with muted sepia and brown tones, creating movement. Dark ink accents define figures and natural elements, blending into a background of distant mountains partly covered by clouds. The sepia-toned palette gives the image a warm, cohesive feel, highlighting the natural setting.

artworks.title: A Stag beneath a Mighty Oak
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with brown and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The illustration features a stag standing on a patch of grass and foliage. The perspective is such that the viewer looks slightly upwards at the stag. Above the stag is the horizon, showing a rocky outcrop or hill against the sky in the distance. The image has a detailed, monochromatic palette with shades of brown, beige, and gray. The fur of the stag, tree trunk, and leaves show cross-hatching and delicate lines for texture and depth. The sky is gray with a few clouds, enhancing the earthy tones of the landscape. The detailed illustration aims to capture the natural elegance of the forest scene realistically.

artworks.title: The Glorification of a Prelate
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures in an allegorical scene among clouds. The composition features figures in flowing robes interacting with each other. One figure holds a large oval shield while another appears to be playing a trumpet-like instrument. The figures are depicted as weightless and ethereal, set in a celestial ambiance with swirling cloud forms. The drawing uses delicate lines and subtle shading to convey depth and movement, capturing an expressive and dream-like narrative characteristic of allegorical art.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with Landsberg Castle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image depicts rolling hills extending into the distance, with a horizon line placed higher in the frame. Shapes that suggest distant hills or mountains can be seen on the horizon. Brushstrokes are loose and light, hinting at an impressionistic style. Portions of the canvas are left untouched. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones including greens, browns, and grays, with hints of yellow and blue. The foreground features shaded greens and browns with sparse trees, transitioning to sunlit plains extending towards the distant hills under a pale sky.

artworks.title: Trees with Dense Undergrowth
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink on very light green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from beneath a canopy of tall trees, looking upward. The scene captures an intricate pattern of tree trunks and branches, rising steeply. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is mainly on the trees and the dense array of leaves filtering the light. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, with quick, gestural marks suggesting the leaves and bark textures. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by rich sepia tones and varying shades of brown. Light and shadow interplay nicely, adding depth and dimension to the depiction of the foliage and tree trunks.

artworks.title: A Stand of Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink over graphite, with stumped graphite, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows detailed sketches of tree trunks with precise lines depicting bark texture. The trunks and branches fill the frame with no visible horizon. The drawing style includes fine lines for leaves and branches. The color palette is muted with shades of grey. Fallen leaves and branches are depicted near the base of the trees, and thinner lines in the distance suggest more foliage.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, heightened with white gouache and yellow chalk, over graphite with traces of pricking on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate scene showing numerous figures and structures. The image has an oval frame and is rendered on a greyish-blue background with white highlights. Two main groups of figures are depicted, one on the left and a smaller group on the right. The drawing features fine linework, washes, and highlights, giving it a classical appearance. Architectural elements suggest structures like a ship and ruins.

artworks.title: Nude Woman Lying on the Ground
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white gouache on bluish-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: A Young Officer Saying Farewell to His Family
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite, partially varnished, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows multiple people engaged in a scene within a room. A man in a uniform, featuring a dark jacket with gold buttons and a yellow sash, faces two women. The uniform includes a tall black hat adorned with a small emblem and a chin strap. One woman stands directly in front of him, wearing a pale pink dress with puffy sleeves and lace detailing, and a white bonnet, holding his hand. The second woman is standing to the left and slightly behind her, wearing a dress with a white collar and a pink bodice, with her dark hair styled in ringlets framing her face. Beside the women is a pink padded chair, with a small dog resting on the floor nearby and a couple of hats placed on a seat. In the background, an open door reveals two soldiers wearing long grey coats and black boots, with caps matching the style of the uniformed man's. One of these soldiers is bending over as if opening a trunk, while a small child stands near him, wearing a plaid dress. On the wall behind, artwork is displayed, including an oval-shaped painting and another small framed piece. To the left, an open window illuminated by light shows the hint of exterior greenery, and a birdcage is visible on the wall. The room's walls are decorated in a muted green tone, and a richly designed curtain in shades of blue and purple drapes beside the window.

artworks.title: The Hills of Umbria near Perugia
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue-green prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The painting depicts a view from an elevated position looking across a gently undulating landscape. The horizon is high, showing distant hills and mountains blending into the soft sky. Small white clouds float in the sky. Fields suggest farmland beyond the hills. Quick, expressive brushstrokes create texture, especially in the nearby trees. The color palette includes pastel tones of blue, gray, green, and yellow. Trees in the foreground are cooler in color, transitioning to warmer tones in the distance, enhancing depth.
